strings.auth_dbcantconnect: Could not connect to the specified authentication database...
strings.auth_dbcolumnlist:
External table contains the following columns:
{$a}
strings.auth_dbdebugauthdbhelp: Debug ADOdb connection to external database - use when getting empty page during login. Not suitable for production sites.
strings.auth_dbdescription: This method uses an external database table to check whether a given username and password is valid.  If the account is a new one, then information from other fields may also be copied across into Moodle.
strings.auth_dbextrafields:
These fields are optional. You can choose to pre-fill some Moodle user fields with information from the external database fields that you specify here.

If you leave these blank, then defaults will be used.

In either case, the user will be able to edit all of these fields after they log in.
strings.auth_dbfieldpass: Name of the field containing passwords
strings.auth_dbfielduser: Name of the field containing usernames. This field must be a varchar data type.
strings.auth_dbhost: The computer hosting the database server. Use a system DSN entry if using ODBC. Use a PDO DSN entry if using PDO.
strings.auth_dbinsertuserduplicate: Error inserting user {$a->username} - user with this username was already created through '{$a->auth}' plugin.
strings.auth_dbname: Name of the database itself. Leave empty if using an ODBC DSN. Leave empty if your PDO DSN already contains the database name.
strings.auth_dbpasstype:
Specify the format that the password field is using.

Use 'internal' if you want the external database to manage usernames and email addresses, but Moodle to manage passwords. If you use 'internal', you must provide a populated email address field in the external database, and you must enable the \auth_db\task\sync_users scheduled task. Moodle will send an email to new users with a temporary password.
strings.auth_dbsetupsqlhelp: SQL command for special database setup, often used to setup communication encoding - example for MySQL and PostgreSQL: SET NAMES 'utf8'
strings.auth_dbsybasequotinghelp: Sybase style single quote escaping - needed for MS SQL and some other databases. Do not use for MySQL!
strings.auth_dbtable: Name of the table in the database
strings.auth_dbtype: The database type (see the documentation ADOdb - Database Abstraction Layer for PHP for details).
strings.auth_dbupdateusers_description: As well as inserting new users, update existing users.
strings.auth_dbuser: Username with read access to the database
strings.privacy:metadata: The External database authentication plugin does not store any personal data.
